_comment: Single source of truth for headline numbers quoted in docs. All values are the DEFAULT-hyperparameter XGBoost model (models/return_risk_results_{scenario}.json) — the shipped return_risk_xgb_v1.json equivalent — so every number in a scenario row comes from one file (no tuned-vs-default mixing). Tuned champion AUCs live in models/tune_results_{scenario}.json and reports/scenario_comparison.md only.
